comparison.objective: Snap a lid around a cup rim; candidate removes a retained terminal.
comparison.physical_skill: Progressive circumferential pressing while stabilizing a fragile cup versus dual-blade insertion and sustained tang release during withdrawal.
comparison.success_condition: All lid sectors seated without tipping or denting versus one terminal removed while housing and neighboring terminals remain intact.
comparison.reason: Opposite retention operations use materially different contact geometry, force direction, and failure modes.
